concept.title: Concept
concept.tagline: A tool for your career and skill growth that grows together with you, instead of asking you to fill out a static profile once.
concept.loopVision: Sketch out, even roughly, the kind of career you want to build — in Vision or on the Dashboard
concept.loopSkillTrack: Keep recording and updating the skills and activity you actually have
concept.loopRecord: Record your education, work history, and projects — at work or in the open (OSS)
concept.loopReflect: Reflect: revisit what you wrote in step 1, and think about what's still missing
concept.loopPrepare: Prepare to take the next step in your career (resume generation, a job-posting gap check...). Deeper LLM-assisted support for this step is still in development
concept.loopBranchLabel: 4 back to 1 is the main flow. It occasionally detours through 5 first
concept.loopNote: The main flow is 4 back to 1: reflecting on your Vision leads straight back into recording more activity and skills. Every so often it detours through step 5 instead — resume generation, a job-posting gap check — before circling back to 1. Every screen in this app — Dashboard, Vision, Profile, Activity, Skills — is a different view onto that same append-only activity log, added to a little at a time rather than reset each time around.
concept.selfHostedBody: No accounts, no multi-tenancy. Run your own instance the way you'd self-host a personal finance tool — your career data stays on your own server.
concept.freeTextTitle: Free-text skills, not a fixed taxonomy
concept.freeTextBody: Skills are stored as the natural language the LLM extracts from your activity, or that you type directly — not normalized IDs from a predefined list.
concept.llmOptionalBody: Extracting skills from free text, and the two AI Integration features (growth guidance, job-posting gap check), are the only things that call an LLM. Everything else — adding or editing a skill by hand, career path goals, Vision, Self PR, generating a resume, backup and restore — works fully with no LLM configured at all.
concept.pluggableLlmBody: When a feature does call one, it talks to any OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint — a cloud API or a local Ollama server. Configured from Settings, not hardcoded.
concept.evidenceNotAssessmentBody: Skills mostly come from things you already have (a resume, a certificate, a project description) rather than from filling out a skill matrix from memory.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure the LLM connection. Any OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint works — cloud API or local Ollama.
settings.backupHint: Download all of your career data (activity, skills, profile, goals — with history, links, self PR history, resume history) as a single JSON file. Your LLM connection settings are not included.
settings.importHint: Upload a backup JSON file (from this app's own backup download) to restore its records. This adds records — it does not delete or replace anything already here.
settings.confirmImport: Import this file's records into your data? This cannot be undone from the UI.
settings.sampleHint: Load a small fictional career history (skills, employment, projects, activity) so you can see what a populated app looks like. Adds records — safe to run on an empty install, but will mix in with any real data you've already added.
settings.confirmLoadSample: Load the bundled sample data into your app now?
settings.confirmResetSample: Remove everything that sample data loaded (in any load so far)? Anything you've added yourself is left untouched.
